quiet: Smith and Lee studied stem cell growth in culture for several years.
Brown and colleagues measured lead in drinking water across the city.
Garcia described protein folding in yeast in a long review.
Chen and Park looked at soil microbes during a severe drought.
Ito tracked arsenic exposure in children living near the mine.
Novak built graphene membranes in a small lab in Prague.
Khan and his team followed heart failure patients for a decade.
Weber found bacterial biofilms growing inside old water pipes.
